newsitem.title: USA: Helmerich & Payne sees positive trends.
newsitem.headline: Helmerich & Payne sees positive trends.

text.p: Helmerich & Payne Inc, a contract driller, said Thursday it expects to benefit from recent strong trends in spending for exploration and production.

"Industry survey information indicates that exploration and production spending growth is at its strongest since 1981," said President Hans Helmerich. "Fundamental improvement such as this obviously has a very positive impact on the contract drilling business," he said in a news release.
"I'm also encouraged by what appears to be the long awaited equilibrium in supply and demand in the natural gas market," he added.

Earlier today, Helmerich & Payne reported fiscal 1997 third quarter earnings rose to $23.6 million or $0.95 a share from $13.2 million or $0.53 in the same period a year ago. Revenues increased to $129.8 million from $101.4 million in the fiscal 1996 third quarter.
Contract drilling in the fiscal 1997 third quarter increased. All of the company's U.S. land rigs were used during the third quarter and 62 percent of U.S. platform rigs.
